symptom: The redirect administration does not show the promised complete address mapping and offers no deletion action.
expected_behavior: The admin shows every effective legacy and managed mapping and an editor can delete one safely.
environment: Local candidate branch release/v628-slider-state-machine on 2026-10-25, redirect admin and Worker routing.

steps: Inspect the bundled redirect inventory totals.
Inspect the admin GET query and page actions.
reproduction.evidence: The inventory reports 3533 dispositions; GET reads only vii_redirects LIMIT 500; the page and API have no delete action.

observations.observation: Bundled redirects are evaluated by the Worker after managed database lookup.
The admin list reads only the managed database.

hypotheses.mechanism: The operational inventory is split between a bundled map and the managed database, but the admin reads only the latter.
hypotheses.prediction: Bundled counts will greatly exceed visible admin rows.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Compare inventory stats and GET implementation.
hypotheses.result: 3533 bundled dispositions versus a database-only LIMIT 500 query.

hypotheses.mechanism: The complete rows exist in the API but the page hides them through client filtering.
hypotheses.prediction: The GET route would merge the bundled JSON or expose its counts.
hypotheses.result: No inventory import or merge exists in the GET route.

fix.change: Merge bundled and managed mappings in one paginated admin read model, add a deleted tombstone and audited DELETE path, and suppress legacy fallback for tombstoned sources.
fix.evidence: The merged model reports all 3533 baseline dispositions, actual D1 migration and tombstone persistence passed, and the rebuilt Worker passed redirect regression tests.

regression_checks.check: Merged bundled and managed inventory precedence
regression_checks.evidence: Focused inventory tests cover full count, override precedence, deletion exclusion and search beyond page one.
Actual Miniflare D1 upgraded the legacy table twice safely and re-read a persisted deletion tombstone.
Post-build redirect, launch SEO and central admin permission families passed 18 of 18 tests.

regression_checks.check: Whole project regression and production build
regression_checks.evidence: The production build passed and the full suite passed 1611 of 1611 tests.

remaining_unknowns: Authenticated production visual state remains unverified until publication.
authorization_boundary: Diagnose, repair and verify locally; do not publish without explicit authorization.
